_doc: Per-mob survivor overrides (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4), keyed by the original mob id. exp_item: the signature Etc item dropped as the EXP pickup (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 5). mesos: [min, max) meso drop range, tier B (v83 server drop data, used as facts; no entry = the level fallback in balance.json mesos). Optional: hp_mult, speed_mult (on top of balance.mob_speed_factor), can_jump (bool), hit_time (s). name is an English fallback; the game shows String.wz/Mob.img names. Canonical stats come from Mob.wz and are never edited here. banish_message: a boss's Banish (MobSkill 129) notice.
